summary: Proverbs invites a son to taste the honey that is sweet on his palate. Psalm 19 draws on the same taste to describe Yahweh’s judgments.

senses.definition: The honey can be tasted or compared with drops falling from lips. Psalm 19 pairs the noun with the plural for honeycombs.

note: The consonants of נֹפֶת support treating it separately from נֶפֶשׁ. Whether the noun originally referred to the comb or to the honey flowing from it remains open.
